scope: Read-only owner/workspace sequence recovery and sanitized preparation phase diagnostics in existing controls.
riskAnalysis: Expose validated bounded historical sequence summaries only to the verified original owner/workspace; no task revival, registration, approval, funding or inference. Typed whitelist prevents nested private values. Fixed phases/codes never display raw exceptions or provider content.

threatModel.assets: Owner/workspace sequence identities, immutable history, source/configuration bindings, retained financial uncertainty and secret-free diagnostics.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Private stored sequence rows to verified owner-only readback and textContent rendering; untrusted error text to finite diagnostic classification.
threatModel.abuseCases: Cross-owner or tenant read, nested values inside known keys, malformed hashes or cohorts, stale task authority, false registration absence and repeated provider mutation.
threatModel.mitigations: Both identity hashes before projection; existing sequence validity/cohort accounting; max8 rows; typed runtime/summary projections; omit malformed; executionAuthorized false; finite codes and fixed method phases; unchanged task/release/spending gates.

rollback: Restore last qualified paid-disabled feature Preview; preserve all records and failures. No history deletion or task revival. Keep paid execution blocked until exact stored sequence state is reconciled.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Incomplete, refused or malformed output remains rejected; no fake artifact.
negativePaths.stale-state: Old policies, grants and release fingerprints cannot authorize new execution.
negativePaths.concurrency: Serial cumulative admission and existing CAS; predecessor must be closed and clean.
negativePaths.cancellation: Revocation and emergency stop remain authoritative; no retry after failure.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Cancel before/inside/after child, await actual termination/disposal; unknown or failed cleanup stays blocked. Remote authorization cannot outlive original authority.
negativePaths.api-outage: No automatic paid retry; preserve sanitized diagnostic and usage uncertainty.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Reject workers/services, foreign owners/workspaces, stale source/review manifests, nonfalse flags, live leases/grants, altered failure/preparation/original record, and unsupported cleanup evidence.
negativePaths.spending-limit: Existing aggregate authorization and token/call/time caps preserved across distinct successors.
negativePaths.partial-execution: A complete model response is not a preserved implementation artifact; only actual accepted stage receipts reach downstream roles.

proactiveReview.threats: Cross-owner or tenant read, nested values inside known keys, malformed hashes or cohorts, stale task authority, false registration absence and repeated provider mutation.
